title: feat(studio): the list-view panel edits a chart view's dataset binding (dataset, measures, dimensions)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio › 界面 › 列表视图面板，图表视图多了一个「图表数据」区块：按名称列出以本对象为基础的数据集，选定后按名称列出它的度量和维度，每次选择都自动保存到该视图的 `chart`（`dataset` / `values` / `dimensions`），图表类型也可在规范列出的五种里切换。
- 为什么改：图表视图的数据集绑定此前只能在「添加视图」对话框里设一次，建好后在 Studio 里无处可改。
- 风险与回滚：只动 Studio 面板、与「添加视图」对话框共用的一个读取 hook 和新增 i18n 键；换数据集时只保留新数据集也声明的度量/维度，度量清空则像其它必填项一样暂扣不发；整个 PR 回滚即恢复原状，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ListViewChartSection.tsx` 的 `pickDataset` 与 `MemberList`、`ListViewTypeSection.tsx` 里 `listViewTypeHeldEdit` 新增的 chart 分支、`objectDatasets.ts`（对话框改为经它读取）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.chartBinding-27933.test.tsx`，预期 9 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27933

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **A "Chart data" section in the list-view panel of a chart view** (`studio-design/ListViewChartSection.tsx`, wired in `ObjectListViewInspector` beside the kanban card and type-settings sections). It edits the list body's `chart` block (`ListChartConfigSchema`):
  - **Dataset**: the datasets whose base `object` is this object, by label (`LABEL (name)`), never another object's. The draft-overlaid catalog is read inside the Studio's draft world (`useStudioDatasetAuthoring`, as the report and dashboard inspectors do).
  - **Measures** (`values`) and **Dimensions** (`dimensions`): the bound dataset's own members, picked by label, stored by name, each removable.
  - **Chart type**: the spec's `chartType` enum, read from the spec's JSONSchema for the block; no option beyond it.
  - Every pick goes through the same `useObjectListViewDraft` buffer and pillar autosave as every other list-view setting.
- **Switching dataset**: the measures and dimensions the new dataset also declares are kept; the rest are dropped, since a name the dataset does not declare binds nothing. A catalog entry that lists no member at all (a name-only summary) keeps none.
- **No measure left**: the `values` key is removed rather than written as `[]`. `objectHeldInput` counts only an absent or empty-string input as unset, so `[]` would be sent and refused with a 422; an absent key is held. `listViewTypeHeldEdit` now asks `ListViewSchema` about the `chart` block too, naming the input by the section's own label, so "Show me" focuses it.
- **Stale names**: a stored measure or dimension the bound dataset does not declare is shown with a "Not in this dataset" mark and its remove button. A stored dataset that is not one of this object's is shown in the picker, marked.
- **Read failures**: the catalog read fails ⇒ the stored dataset, measures and dimensions are shown as saved with the reason, and no picker is offered; the bound dataset's member read fails ⇒ the same for its members. The rest of the panel is unaffected.
- **No dataset on the object**: the section says so and draws no picker.
- **Shared reading** (`studio-design/objectDatasets.ts`, `useObjectDatasetBinding` + `datasetOptionLabel`): the Create View dialog's own filter-and-resolve code moved here unchanged and the dialog now calls it. The dialog's pickers are single-choice rows in its generic required-pick loop, so the pickers themselves are not shared; the panel's measure and dimension lists are multi-valued.
- i18n: new `engine.studio.inspector.listView.chart.*` keys in the studio en and zh packs only; no existing en string changed.

## Tests

- New `ObjectListViewInspector.chartBinding-27933.test.tsx`: the real `useObjectListViewDraft` and panel over a real `MetadataClient` whose transport serves the dataset catalog and judges each view PUT with the installed spec's `view` schema.
- `CreateViewDialog.chartBinding-11576` and the other dialog suites stay green on the shared hook.

## Acceptance notes

- **Shared, not copied — the reading only.** The Create View dialog's filter-and-resolve code is what moved into `useObjectDatasetBinding`; its pickers stay its own (single-choice rows of its generic required-pick loop, where the panel's measures and dimensions are ordered multi-valued lists). Its six suites, `CreateViewDialog.chartBinding-11576` included, and `ObjectView.createChartView-11576` are green on the shared hook.
- **Why `values` is removed rather than emptied.** `objectHeldInput` treats only an absent or empty-string input as unset; `values: []` would be judged finished-but-wrong and sent, then refused with a 422 (the spec's `.min(1)`). Removing the key makes the pillar hold the edit with "Measures in the view's Chart settings needs a value", and "Show me" lands on the measure picker (its `label` names the add trigger).
- **Name-only catalog entries.** If a dataset list ever answers names without members, switching to such a dataset keeps no measure or dimension (nothing is known to carry over); the members then load through `useDatasetSemantics` as before.
- **Draft world.** Inside the Interfaces pillar the section reads `?preview=draft` (the `StudioDatasetAuthoringContext` signal the report and dashboard inspectors use), so a dataset drafted in the package is offered. Outside it, the published list.
- **Not changed.** No endpoint, client or reader; no chart rendering; `chartType` offers exactly the spec enum (`bar`, `line`, `pie`, `area`, `scatter`), labelled with the existing widget-type strings. The generic type-settings section still excludes `chart`, and the #27895 control pin for that is unchanged (its docblock now names the new section). `content/docs/frontend/` is not touched, as on the two predecessor panel PRs.
